data.title: Dunning notice for overdue electricity and water advance payments
data.summary: Stadtwerke Beispielsoest GmbH sent a dunning notice dated 19 November 2026 because the October and November 2026 electricity and water advance payments (Abschläge) of €112.00 each were not received. Including a €2.00 dunning fee, the total overdue amount of €226.00 is demanded by 10 December 2026, otherwise the supply may be interrupted after prior notice.
data.explanation: Your utility provider is asking you to pay €226.00 in total — two missed monthly advance payments plus a small dunning fee — by 10 December 2026. Pay this amount to the IBAN shown, using your Vertragskonto number 4007 3318 52 as reference, to avoid further action. If the payments were already made, check your bank transfers and contact the provider with proof. If you ignore this, the letter warns that the electricity and water supply could be interrupted after a further warning. If you dispute the amount, it may help to contact the provider directly or seek advice.
